# Ideafridge

> Ideafridge provides a signal-driven cybersecurity GTM media engine for B2B revenue teams.

Canonical: https://ideafridge.com/
Sitemap: https://ideafridge.com/sitemap.xml
Full profile: https://ideafridge.com/llms-full.txt
Privacy: https://ideafridge.com/privacy.html
Terms: https://ideafridge.com/terms.html

## Core offering
- Continuous monitoring of cybersecurity market events.
- Narrative extraction from signals (breaches, funding, regulation, positioning).
- Fast deployment of GTM assets for SDRs, AEs, founders, and marketing teams.

## Target users
- Cybersecurity founders and GTM leaders.
- SDR and AE teams that need rapid outbound relevance.
- Marketing teams responsible for narrative velocity and enablement.

- Data policy: see Privacy Protocol.
